liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Althea** (2 reviews): Listener notes Jerry wails during Althea and the Let It Grow to Deal transition; The Althea performance is characterized as relaxed and groovy [25][33]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Listener cites Tennessee Jed and Let It Grow as favorite organic versions [27]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Jerry plays lightning fast, letter perfect notes inside notes on Let It Grow [33]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-05-01.142846.fob.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1981-05-01.sbd.hinko.29087.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 171 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [6]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording is described as sweet, clean, and tight [32]
- **gd1981-05-01.175350.sbd.zavislak.miller.clugston.vocal.phase.repair.flac1648**: soundboard; 22 songs; 172 min [9]
- **gd1981-05-01.163740.sbd.zavislak.miller.clugston.flac1648**: soundboard; 22 songs; 172 min [10]
- **gd81-05-01.wise.clugston.2218.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 174 min; rated 4.62/5 by 37 [11]. Said about its sound: Listener calls the audience recording fine and the best they have heard; Recording features crystal clear music, full presence, and audible crowd responses; Listener describes the show as having a lightning quick pace and good sound [23][24][30][34]
- **gd1981-05-01.147855.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 22 songs; 179 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [12]

## Around the show

- Attendees waited two hours in line due to a nearby fair before entering [29]
- Festival seating arrangement made the experience better for the attendee [29]
- Bobby and Jerry swapped solos and slide during Little Red Rooster [32]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-05-01.142846.fob.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell XLII-S); Transfer Info: Master Cassettes… [1]. Also: Jim Wise recorded the show; Charlie Miller coordinated the transcription effort [1]
- **gd1981-05-01.sbd.hinko.29087.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko; source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1981-05-01.175350.sbd.zavislak.miller.clugston.vocal.phase.repair.flac1648**: taped by Matthew Zavislak for the source DAT; transferred by Mastered by Scott Clugston February 2023 Vocal Phase Correction via Charlie Miller (November 2025); source: Master Soundboard Cassettes > Cassettes > DAT (16-bit/48kHz) [9]
- **gd1981-05-01.163740.sbd.zavislak.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Matthew Zavislak; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Cassettes > Cassettes > DAT (16-bit/48kHz) [10]. Also: Charlie Miller performed vocal phase correction on the soundboard recording in November 2025 [10]
- **gd81-05-01.wise.clugston.2218.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 421's [11]
- **gd1981-05-01.147855.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M [12]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Hampton Roads, Virginia - May 1, 1981](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/hampton-roads-virginia-may-1-1981) [36]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Hampton Coliseum - May 1, 1981](https://www.dead.net/show/may-1-1981-0) [37]
- Poster by Shazam: [Let It Grow (Live at Hampton Coliseum, Hampton, VA, 5/1/1981) - Grateful Dead: Song Lyrics, Music Videos & Concerts](https://www.shazam.com/song/1800175331/let-it-grow-live-at-hampton-coliseum-hampton-va-511981) [38]
